title: Transient Coherence and Multiscale Spectral Structure after a Mass Quench in a 1+1-Dimensional Scalar Field
summary: A mass quench generates anomalous pair correlations that are absent from the final particle occupations. For a free real scalar field in $1+1$ dimensions, we define a bilocal observable by smearing the statistical Keldysh correlator with a Morlet kernel on the finite post-quench relative-time interval. Its excess over the dephased correlator gives a dimensionless relative coherence weight.
